DESCRIPTION.locations: Directory configuration for PST processing, conversion and extraction.
DESCRIPTION.locations.pst_dir: Directory containing the source PST files.
DESCRIPTION.locations.mbox_dir: Directory where converted MBOX files are written.
DESCRIPTION.locations.eml_dir: Directory where converted EML files are written.
DESCRIPTION.locations.contacts_dir: Directory where extracted contacts are saved as VCard (.vcf) files.
DESCRIPTION.locations.calendars_dir: Directory where extracted calendar appointments are saved as iCalendar (.ics) files.
DESCRIPTION.locations.attachments_dir: Directory where extracted email attachments are saved.
DESCRIPTION.locations.work_dir: Temporary working directory used when viewing and processing PST emails.
